assertion_results.text: Identifies mass assignment allowing privilege escalation via extra body fields (role/isVerified)
assertion_results.evidence: "Authorization: mass assignment of `role`... any account can make itself an admin, which means full privilege escalation."

assertion_results.text: Gives the concrete exploit: include role=admin (or isVerified=true) in the request body
assertion_results.evidence: "a logged-in user sends `PUT /profile {\"role\":\"admin\"}`. The whole body goes straight into `User.update`."

assertion_results.text: Fix: allowlist updatable fields; never bind sensitive fields from client input
assertion_results.evidence: "allowlist the writable fields... `const { name, bio, email } = req.body`"; "leave `isVerified` out of the allowlist. Only the server sets it"

assertion_results.text: Rates it High/Critical with exploit + fix
assertion_results.evidence: Listed under "🔴 Critical" as item 1 with "Exploit: ... {\"role\":\"admin\"}" and "Fix: allowlist the writable fields"
